description: This Java source file defines the DefaultNativeAssetRepository class, which interacts with the database to retrieve asset profile entity information, including methods for querying assets and converting database rows into ProfileEntityIdInfo objects.

classes.name: DefaultNativeAssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class for native asset data operations, extending AbstractNativeRepository and implementing NativeAssetRepository.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated profile entity ID information for all assets.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated profile entity ID information filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: toInfo
methods.description: Converts a database row map into a ProfileEntityIdInfo object.
